<!--
Quarto's colour fields are latex's: linkcolor for a link inside the document,
urlcolor for one that leaves it, citecolor for a citation, filecolor for a
file, and toccolor for the lists of contents, figures and tables.

The pdf and the typst have answered to them for a while. .docx and .html did
not: every .docx link carries the reference document's one Hyperlink style,
and a web page takes its colours from the theme. Four character styles in the
reference document and a stylesheet in the head are what they answer with.

A colour is named the way latex names it, and xcolor's table is what resolves
the name, so that green is the same green in all four.
-->
